findings.reason: Pseudo-planche push-up requires extreme scapular protraction, forward lean and straight-arm control; it is an advanced calisthenics skill, not a low-demand movement.
The assist machine REMOVES load. Storing it as added_weight makes the logged number mean the opposite of the resistance actually handled.
bodyweight=true and tracking_type=bodyweight_reps, so there is no external load to input.
Pure bodyweight movement: performance depends on the athlete's mass.
Equipment is dumbbell/barbell; the Cuban press is a free-weight movement with no cable stack.
A free-weight dumbbell/barbell lift is comparable across gyms; equipment_instance is for a single machine.
Rope skipping carries no external load; the athlete moves only their own bodyweight.
The stored description itself calls it a compound of a forward lunge (hip + knee) plus an overhead triceps extension.
Chest-supported incline row removes the unsupported torso lever; the sibling chest_supported_row in the same catalogue stores low.
Resistance comes from an externally held kettlebell, not from body leverage; every other loaded squat in the sample stores gravity.
The kettlebells are only handles: tracking_type=bodyweight_reps and resistance_source=bodyweight_leverage contradict bodyweight=false.
Explosive push-off and landing on kettlebell handles; the plain plyo_push_up in the same sample stores moderate.
Load on a lever/machine deadlift depends on that machine's leverage, so it is not comparable across gyms.
Named and described as a single-leg heel raise.
tracking_type=bodyweight_reps and resistance_source=bodyweight_leverage with no external load.
The row links a barbell and a dumbbell while tracking bodyweight_reps/bodyweight_aware; it is internally contradictory - either drop the implements or store gravity + weight_reps.
The ring support hold is a pure bodyweight isometric; tracking is time/bodyweight_aware.
A reverse sled march is dynamic locomotion against sled friction/mass, not an isometric hold.

summary: 80 exercises sampled at random (seed 90210) from the 2502 active rows of the exercises schema. 39 of them carry at least one stored fact that contradicts the movement (48.75%). Enum-level fields are in reasonable shape; the residual damage is concentrated in exercise_muscle. Three recurring families account for most of it: (a) an antagonist or an unrelated muscle promoted to PRIMARY (rectus_abdominis on calf raises, wrist curls, side planks, dips, sled marches; tibialis_anterior on a calf raise; biceps_femoris on a leg extension; deltoid_anterior on reverse flies and rear raises); (b) anterior deltoid marked PRIMARY on six overhead triceps-extension isolations, where it is only an isometric stabiliser; (c) skeleton muscle sets on compound movements - split_jerk, weighted_parallel_bar_dip, tall_kneeling_band_press, neutral_grip_floor_press and wall_reverse_sled_march each have a single, mostly wrong primary and no real prime movers. A smaller cluster is equipment/tracking incoherence: farmer_walk_on_toes and alternating_split_stance_calf_pulse point at a standing calf machine, slider_leg_curl at a lying leg-curl machine, assisted_pull_up at a bare pull-up bar with load_input_mode=added_weight for a movement that subtracts load, and sumo_squat_pulse links a barbell and a dumbbell while tracking bodyweight_reps. Four bodyweight-only exercises (double_under_skipping, kettlebell_plyo_push_up, stability_ball_crunch, turnout_ring_support_hold) still store bodyweight=false while their tracking profile says otherwise. kinetic_chain, spotter_policy and spinal_loading were essentially clean across the sample.
